verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Honeybadger serves an llms.txt at docs.honeybadger.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It also publishes per-topic agent-oriented reference files under /_llms-txt/ (product, insights, Python, Cocoa, other) and markdown versions of doc pages such as mcp.md, so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable docs. missing for 10: first-party guidance explaining how to use the llms.txt/agent docs, independent hands-on reports of agents consuming them successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
